[Problem]{.card-kicker} **K-th Not Divisible by n** [CF 1352C · K-th Not Divisible by n](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/1352/C){rating="1200"}

$k$ up to $10^9$ with 1000 tests means even $O(k)$ per test is $10^{12}$ steps. We need $O(1)$ or $O(\log k)$. In every block of $n$ consecutive integers, exactly $n-1$ are not divisible by $n$, so the answer is $k$ plus the number of multiples of $n$ skipped along the way.

[Solved in full in @sec-cx-p1-kth.]{.card-link}

:::
